title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, terms from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

On volume: we plan 4580 pcs per year and offer a 24- or 36-month commitment. This gives your plant stable, plannable load for the whole term. The attached packages also adjust payment terms. Could you confirm which package suits you best?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, terms from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your data regarding the should-cost estimate and volume increase, which we have factored into our calculation. However, as to the price history and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

We welcome the proposed 36-month commitment and 60-day payment terms to provide stable planning for both sides. In response to this longer commitment, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 429.42. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €429.42 per unit, for a volume of 4580 pcs per year.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – volume and commitment for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for verifying our data.

On volume: we can commit to 4580 pcs per year, which covers our full need. We offer this either for 24 months or for the 36-month term you welcomed. The longer term secures your plant's load and removes renewal workload for both sides until the end of 2029.

The attached packages keep your 90-day payment terms and move our price a clear step toward yours. Under the 36-month package you have an additional year of planned volume.

Which of the two packages can you confirm? Please also let us know the earliest lead time you can support for call-offs.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – volume and commitment for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot comprises a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Due to the strict management freeze on price reductions, we must maintain our price of EUR 430.88 for the requested 90-day payment term. We welcome your commitment to a 36-month contract, which secures stable planning for both sides. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €430.88 per unit. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our logistics colleagues will contact you shortly to confirm the earliest possible lead time for your call-offs. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Frame agreement part:350020 – revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and the delivery schedule.

We confirm 4580 pcs per year, over either 24 or 36 months, with your 90-day payment terms. We are happy to call off in line with your monthly schedule. We will place January call-offs before your holiday shutdown, so that your planning stays steady.

The attached packages move our price a further step toward yours. The 36-month option gives your plant an additional year of secured load.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
